info.name: StyleMind Identity — Manage Profile US-02.05
info.description: Importable local collection for the four approved profile APIs. No Register, Verify, Forgot Password, email, seed or delete/cleanup request is included. Use dedicated verified CUSTOMER test accounts, not personal accounts. Login creates refresh sessions and profile requests mutate test data. Never save/export a populated collection or runner environment into the repository.

item.name: 01 — Login and identify test accounts
item.description: Prerequisite for folders 02–06. Configure two dedicated, verified CUSTOMER accounts in the active local environment. Login/identity failure stops the run so later requests cannot use a missing or stale token. This collection does not register accounts, verify OTPs, send mail, or use personal accounts.
